pages: Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, stands with one hand on the rolling cabinet of a spirometry machine, its screen facing him. Middle distance: a flow head and a mouthpiece on a coiled tube, a low-backed chair. Background: a window with an aluminium blind down. Cool daylight.

Colin Preece, a man of sixty-eight, grey stubble, a green checked shirt with the sleeves turned back, sits upright with a mouthpiece between his lips and both hands loose on his knees, his jacket over the chair back. Middle distance: the low chair, the rolling machine cabinet. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Flat daylight.

Colin Preece, a man of sixty-eight, grey stubble, a green checked shirt with the sleeves turned back, sits forward on the low chair with one hand pressed flat on his chest and the other on his thigh. Middle distance: a folded jacket on the chair arm, a stool. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a wall corner. Flat daylight.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, stands at a stadiometer with his hand level at the top of a head and a pen in the other. Middle distance: a disposable mouthpiece, a nose clip. Background: an aluminium blind half down. Cool daylight.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, stands beside the rolling cabinet, looking at a flow curve on the machine screen. Middle distance: a coiled flow tube, a keyboard, the low chair. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight and screen glow on his face.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, sits at the desk with one printed report in his hands, turned so the numbers face away. Middle distance: a keyboard, a monitor, a pen. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Overhead light, and daylight at the window.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, taps once on a trackpad beside a screen where six flow curves are stacked in order. Middle distance: a rolled printout, a keyboard, the low chair. Background: an aluminium blind half down. Cool daylight, screen glow on his face.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, writes on the back of one spare request form held flat on top of the machine cabinet, a pen in his hand. Middle distance: a printed report, a roll of paper. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, lays a mouthpiece and a nose clip on a wiped bench top and checks a wall clock. Middle distance: a stadiometer by the sink, the low chair, a coiled tube. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a door. Cool daylight.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, leans close to a screen where one flow curve falls from a peak in a long straight slope to the floor. Middle distance: a keyboard, the low chair. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight and screen glow.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, holds a printed report flat at arm's length in both hands. Middle distance: a monitor, a pen, a keyboard. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight across the sheet.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, lays two printed reports side by side on the desk, a fingertip holding down the corner of each. Middle distance: a pen, a keyboard, a card. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight across both sheets.

Colin Preece, a man of sixty-eight, grey stubble, a green checked shirt with the sleeves turned back, sits at a desk with one inhaler turned a little and looked at in his hand. Middle distance: a letter, a second inhaler standing on the desk, a chair. Background: a clinic window, a radiator. Flat daylight.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, sits at the bench with one hand resting on the coiled flow tube on the cabinet. Middle distance: the dark machine screen, the low chair, a stethoscope on the bench. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Low afternoon light.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, writes a letter and four figures on the back of one paper report, holding it flat with his other hand. Middle distance: a box of staples, a pen. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight on the sheet.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, stands at the desk with one open folder in front of him, eleven stapled sheets standing on edge inside it. Middle distance: a pen, a ruler, a tray. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool daylight across the folder.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, holds one stapled sheet out flat in both hands towards an open doorway. Middle distance: the bench, a coiled tube, a tray. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a corridor door. Cool daylight from the doorway.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, sits on a concrete stair with one forearm on his knee and the printouts folded in his hand. Middle distance: a handrail, a step, a half landing window. Background: a fire door, a bare wall. Cool daylight from the stair window.

Colin Preece, a man of sixty-eight, grey stubble, a green checked shirt with the sleeves turned back, sits at a desk with two inhalers standing on it and a narrow paper strip held in one hand. Middle distance: a letter, a chair, a pen. Background: a clinic window, a radiator. Flat daylight.

Elijah Sarkies, a boy of seventeen, dark curly hair, a pale blue scrub top under a white short-sleeved coat, stands at the corner of the desk with one hand on an open folder and an unfilled form beside it. Middle distance: a pen, the machine cabinet, the low chair. Background: an aluminium blind half down, a sink. Cool afternoon light.
